mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CBCI_FILE( uuid, file_division, file_division_pk, origin_file_name, store_file_name, file_ext, file_size, file_path, enc_type, input_date ) VALUES ( #{uuid}, #{file_division}, #{file_division_pk}, #{origin_file_name}, #{store_file_name}, #{file_ext}, #{file_size}, #{file_path}, #{enc_type}, now() )
mapper.select: SELECT file_path, concat(origin_file_name, '.', file_ext) as file_name FROM CBCI_FILE WHERE uuid = #{uuid}
SELECT uuid, concat(origin_file_name, '.', file_ext) as file_name, file_size FROM CBCI_FILE WHERE file_division = #{file_division} AND file_division_pk = #{file_division_pk}
SELECT uuid, file_path, concat(store_file_name, '.', file_ext) as file_name FROM CBCI_FILE WHERE file_division = #{file_division} AND file_division_pk = #{file_division_pk}
